limits: Conservative syntax discovery includes type imports and lazy imports; reachability does not prove runtime execution.
Package imports and nonliteral imports remain explicit boundaries. Relative fallback resolution is bounded, not an emulation of every Bun/TypeScript resolution rule.
No semantic review, credential read, module execution, cache qualification or proof promotion is performed.
448 unbound sources are discovery work, not new reviewed semantic bindings.
A zero unresolved-relative-edge count does not resolve external package imports or prove execution.
